rows.prelude:
# ---- ravynOS ----
# ravynos: pinned live ISO -> logged-in desktop -> golden. No install: the
#   0.6.1 disk installer completes but the installed system stalls at
#   launchd before rc (docs/guests/ravynos.md). The ISO is mirror-only --
#   the project deleted every FreeBSD-era release from GitHub and SourceForge.

value.kbd_note: Do NOT send Cmd-Shift-Q: it quits WindowServer and 0.6.x ships no Filer to restart it, leaving a console until the next reset.
value.note: UEFI live-ISO guest: q35 + OVMF pflash pair, carrier disk declared first so savevm keeps the vmstate out of the variable store.

labctl.notes: No exec channel: the 0.6.1 live image runs no sshd. Drive it through the framebuffer (labctl shot / pointer + keys).

render.stationsManifestPrelude:
# ravynos (VMID 173) — ravynOS 0.6.1 "Hyperpop Hyena", the LAST
#   FreeBSD-based ravynOS. VERBATIM launcher; its header is the device-set
#   ledger and explains the three things that look wrong but are not: the
#   guest boots a READ-ONLY live ISO, so an otherwise unused carrier qcow2
#   is declared FIRST to hold the vmstate (savevm picks its device by
#   -drive order, and the pflash pair would otherwise swallow the RAM
#   image); the OVMF variable store is qcow2 and WRITABLE (read-only hangs
#   OVMF before display init, raw makes savevm refuse); and input is USB,
#   not PS/2 or virtio, because upstream says those lag.
#   Cold boot stops at the LoginWindow — the golden is the exhibit.
render.bindingComment: ideal: any 2020s PC — the point is that it is not a Mac

museum.lineage: airyx → ravynOS (FreeBSD 15 + a clean-room Cocoa stack)
museum.blurb: A pre-alpha BSD wearing a Mac's clothes: global menu bar, Dock and Command-key shortcuts over FreeBSD 15. Four days after this build shipped, its makers threw the FreeBSD kernel away and deleted every release of this line — so 0.6.1 is the last ravynOS of its kind.
museum.notes: Live-ISO station: the guest boots the read-only 0.6.1 ISO and the golden holds the logged-in desktop. Cold boot stops at the LoginWindow and waits for a human, so the golden is what makes it an exhibit. No exec channel — the live image runs no sshd.
museum.periodBrowser: none — 0.6.x ships no browser at all; the clean-room Cocoa stack is nowhere near far enough along to host one

notes: Live-ISO exhibit: 0.6.1's disk installer completes but the installed system stalls at 'pid 1 comm launchd: nosys 689' before rc and never reaches a desktop. Refuted the entropy hypothesis (virtio-rng changes nothing). See docs/guests/ravynos.md.
Media is mirror-only. The project deleted every FreeBSD-era release from GitHub and SourceForge on/after 2025-10-29; the SHA-256 recorded in docs/lab/ASSETS-MANIFEST.md is the acceptance gate.
